proofread = to check a text for errors before submitting it
word limit = the maximum (and sometimes minimum) number of words allowed
abstract = a short summary of a paper or dissertation placed at the start
special educational needs = learning difficulties or disabilities that require extra support in school
dyslexia = a difficulty with reading and spelling that is not due to low intelligence
gifted pupil = a school student whose ability is well above the typical level
underachieve = to do less well than your ability suggests
inclusive education = schooling that educates pupils with diverse needs in ordinary settings where possible
mainstream school = an ordinary school, as opposed to a specialist separate setting
truancy = the habit of staying away from school without permission
learning outcomes = the knowledge and skills a course claims students will gain
scaffolding = temporary help that is withdrawn as the learner becomes able to work alone
supply teacher = a teacher who covers classes when the regular teacher is absent
teaching assistant = a member of staff who supports the teacher and individual pupils
head of department = the teacher in charge of a subject area in a school
newly qualified teacher = a teacher in the first year after gaining qualified teacher status
classroom management = the skills of organising behaviour and attention so that teaching can happen
permanent exclusion = removing a pupil from the school roll as a last disciplinary step
suspension = a temporary ban from attending school as a punishment
education reform = a planned change to how schools, exams or funding work
